planets.name: EPIC 211945201 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 211945201 with a 19.5-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: EPIC 211945201 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 211945201. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2018): disc_year 2018, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 19.4921473, pl_radj 0.51387278, pl_bmassj 0.03460987

quotes.title: K2-236b
quotes.card: It is also called EPIC 211945201 b.
quotes.introduction: Its mass is 27 Earths, it takes 19.5 days to complete one orbit of its star, and is 0.148 AU from its star.
